brief:
Israeli occupation forces stormed Salfit city and raided the Palestinian Authority's Prisoners Affairs Commission office, according to Maan Wire. Soldiers ransacked the facility and its contents during the incursion.

The raid targeted one of the PA's key institutions responsible for detainee and prisoner matters. No further details on the scale of damage or purpose of the operation were immediately available.
title: Israeli forces raid Salfit, ransack prisoners affairs office
